narr: A line of severe thunderstorms associated with a strong cold front moving through the area produced widespread wind damage across the region.
ev: Wilkinson County EMA reported 9 houses and mobile homes flooded as Percy Creek rose above its embankment. Trapped residents had to be rescued.
lsr: WILKINSON COUNTY EMA REPORTED 9 HOUSES AND 5 MOBILE FLOODED AS THE PERCY CREEK ROSE ABOVE ITS EMBANKMENT. TRAPPED RESIDENTS HAD TO BE RESCUED. TIME ESTIMATED BASED ON RADAR.
